player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Gyrotech''') posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire

description: Don't Chadra-Fans look overly wimpy? Well, with Kabe at the Audience Chamber and all them having destiny 4, this deck really eats the opponent alive
cards: Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire
You Will Take Me To Jabba Now
posted: You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (x2)
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (5)': Agents In The Court, Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, The Signal and Seeking An Audience; these count toward the 60. Seeking An Audience is the starting Effect; The Signal is listed in the starting section but is not a starting interrupt.

Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace) (the strategy uses Artoo's text to fetch A Gift and go undercover); 'Tatooine Cantina' dested Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Ounee Ta' dested the 2001 Effect Ounee Ta (not the Reflections III shield).
The draft had this deck as Dark; the post is tagged Light and plays the Light Agents In The Court objective.
Kelly Brown posted a later version of this deck six days later as 'I'm A Chadra-Fan Fan v1 1' (DeckTech 16267, 28 May 2001).
